name: Mixed Goal Benchmark Bank
purpose: Manual unseen benchmark for MultiQuery recall, precision, grounded correctness, semantic consistency and latency. Test-only; not imported by production runtime or QA registry.

cases.question: In `enabled && update_state()`, the function on the right changes persistent state. Which MISRA requirement applies?
Kung may `cond || write_status()` at may persistent side effect yung right-hand call, anong MISRA rule ang relevant?
Can an ordinary integer expression be used directly as an if condition when its essential type is not Boolean?
Sa MISRA, okay ba na numeric value lang ang controlling expression ng while kung hindi essentially Boolean ang type?
A switch handles every currently known enum value but has no default label. Is that acceptable under MISRA C?
Kung kumpleto naman ang listed cases ng switch pero walang `default`, compliant ba iyon sa MISRA?
A function reaches itself again through another helper function. Which MISRA rule covers that call pattern?
Anong MISRA rule ang applicable kapag bumabalik sa parehong function ang call chain kahit dumaan muna sa ibang function?
If a non-void function is called only for its side effects and its returned value is discarded, which MISRA requirement is relevant?
May function na may return value pero tinawag lang siya at hindi ginamit ang ibinalik na value. Anong MISRA rule ang dapat tingnan?
Is it acceptable to save the address of a local automatic variable into storage that remains valid after the function returns?
Pwede bang itago sa persistent object ang address ng local automatic variable kahit tapos na ang lifetime ng local object?
A function-like macro expands one of its parameters inside an expression without enclosing that parameter expansion in parentheses. Which MISRA rule applies?
Sa macro expression, ginagamit ang expanded parameter nang walang sariling parentheses. Anong MISRA requirement ang relevant?
A string-handling library call may write beyond the destination object's bounds. Which MISRA requirement addresses that risk?
Anong MISRA rule ang relevant kung puwedeng lumampas sa bounds ng destination object ang paggamit ng string handling function?
May code modify data through a pointer returned by `getenv`, or should that pointer be treated as read-only under MISRA?
Pwede bang sulatan ang memory gamit ang pointer na galing sa `setlocale` o kailangan itong ituring na const ayon sa MISRA?
The program keeps a pointer returned by `localtime`, calls `localtime` again, then continues using the old pointer. Which MISRA rule is concerned?
May pointer mula sa `strerror`, tapos tumawag ulit sa `strerror` bago gamitin ulit ang lumang pointer. Anong MISRA rule ang applicable?
A function communicates failure through its return value, but the caller ignores that error information. Which MISRA directive applies?
Anong MISRA directive ang relevant kapag may error information ang return value ng function pero hindi ito tine-test ng caller?
A composite arithmetic expression is assigned to an object whose essential type is wider than the expression. Which MISRA rule covers this?
Kung ang result ng composite expression ay ina-assign sa object na mas wide ang essential type, anong MISRA rule ang applicable?
